i manifested every day for 21 days. my brain is quieter.

here’s what actually changed:

→ i stopped doom scrolling at 1am. just... stopped.
→ my screen time dropped from 7 hours to under 3
→ i sleep before midnight now (this one shocked me)
→ i stopped catastrophizing every decision
→ mornings don’t feel like a punishment anymore
→ i actually remember what i want. like, specifically.
→ my anxiety is still there. but it’s quieter.
